concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-au-pricing-fees]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree AU pricing-and-fees snapshot routing account-determined fee types and IC+/IC++ models to exact raw locators while preserving the page's unresolved settled-transaction versus all-authorizations fee-scope wording; not a numeric rate schedule, merchant-specific agreement, currency-conversion guide, or current universal Australian policy
warnings: The raw page describes transaction fees as applying to settled transactions but separately applies the per-transaction fee to all authorizations, including failed transactions, voids, and refunds; retain both without choosing a controlling rule.
The cross-border fee definition is country-based and does not establish multi-currency or foreign-exchange behavior.
